title: An expanded chart joins the points around an empty month with a dashed line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech Gap) has clocked time at {Location-A} in {Month-A} and in {Month-C} (for example July 2026 and September 2026), both within the last twelve months, and no clocked time in {Month-B} (for example August 2026), the month between.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Technician Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months and click View details on Technician Efficiency.
  3. In the Technician filter keep only {Technician-A} ticked.
  4. Look at {Technician-A}'s line across {Month-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: A dashed line joins {Technician-A}'s points for {Month-A} and {Month-C} across {Month-B}.
  • Step 4: The line does not break at {Month-B} and does not drop to zero there.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S9-R9 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 6 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14) and S8-R5 (since version 42); read 14 Oct 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9: “In an expanded chart, a month with no value is drawn as a dashed line joining the points on either side of it. This is how these charts already draw in production. A gap in the line applies only to the sparkline on a tile (S4-R11).”
  • S8-R5: “When the user changes a chart filter, the chart reloads scoped to the selected technicians or advisor.”
